ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS Automatic Sliding Gate - Prequalification & Tender Conditions 1. Scope. Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of an approximately 8 m x 8 ft motorised sliding gate with 8 mm steel cladding, subject to approved d esign and site measurements. 2. Prequalification Requirements. 2.1. Experience. The bidder shall have completed at least two motorised slidin g gate installations withing the last five years, each with a clear opening of at le ast 6 m and comparable gate weight. Submit purchase orders, completion certif icates and verifiable client details. 2.2. Performance. At least one qualifying installation shall have operated satis factorily for twelve months supported by a client performance certificate. 2.3. Manufacturer Support. The bidder shall be the manufacturer of provided tender specific authorisation from the operator manufacturer covering warranty technical support and spare parts. 2.4. Capability. Submit three years audited financial statements, relevant tech nical personnel credentials and a service plan nidifying technicians response arr angements and critical spare parts. Financial thresholds shall be proportionate t o contract value. 2.5. Compliance. Submit a clause-by-clause compliance statements supporting documents and separate deviation schedule. Credentials shall be subject to veri fication. 3. Technical and Material Quality Requirements. 3.1. Engineering. Submit gate drawings and calculations covering actual weig ht structural adequacy wind loads, foundations, anchorage, rollers, anti- derailm ent arrangements and operator suitability for the specified usage and duty cycl e. 3.2. Safety. Provide a site-specific risk assessment and protective measures ad dressing crushing, trapping, shearing and uncontrolled movement. Include obst ruction detection/reversal, photocells, emergency stop, manual release and me chanical stops. 3.3. Material Quality and Samples. Before procurement or fabrication, submi t the material schedule, steel grades, applicable standards and traceable manuf acturer’s test certificates. Provide representative samples of the 8 mm cladding and frame sections, together with a minimum 300 x 300 mm welded and coate d sample panel. Approved samples shall establish the workmanship reference. State thickness tolerances, coating thickness, test methods and acceptance limi

ts in the tender. 3.4. Inspection. Materials shall e new unused and traceable. Thickness welds c oating and components shall be inspected against the approved inspection plan . Substitutions require prior written approval. Rejected materials shall be replac ed at the contractor’s expense repeat testing after confirmed failure shall also b e at the contractor’s expense. 4. Contract and Acceptance Conditions. 4.1. Approvals. Obtain approval of drawing calculations materials and inspectio n plans before fabrication. Approval shall not relieve the contractor of contractu al responsibility. 4.2. Acceptance Testing. Complete factory and site inspections, electrical and safety checks and at least 100 operating cycles under a schedule consistent wit h the specified duty cycle. Verify all controls, safety devices power failure beha viour and manual release. Submit measured force test results where force limit ation is used. 4.3 Warranty and Service. Provide a two year comprehensive warranty from f inal acceptance including parts labour, travel and quarterly preventive mainten ance. Attended breakdowns withing 24 hours and restore operations within 72 h ours, subject to confirmed site feasibility. Secure and isolate unsafe equipment pending repair. 4.4. Support and Handover. Provide manufacturer backed spare parts suppor t for five years, operator training as built drawings, manuals, certificates and test records. Final payments shall follow successful acceptance and closure of d efects. 4.5. Commercial Conditions. Specify delivery milestones, proportionate perfo rmance security and delay damages under applicable procurement rules. qualifi cation requirements shall be relevant measurable and proportionate to the wor k. ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION 1. Type and Dimension. 1.1 Type : Heavy-duty, motorised automatic sliding security gate, singlele af design. 1.2 Gate length: 8 meters (approximate, subject to site measurement). 1.3 Gate height: 8 feet (approx. 2.44 meters). Sheet thickness: 8 mm thick steel sheet.

1.4 Construction: Heavy-duty structural steel frame with fully welded joint s and rein-forced bracing. 2. Material and Fabrication 2.1 Frame fabricated from suitable heavy-duty structural mild steel sectio ns. 2.2 Gate cladding made of 4 mm thick steel plate, continuously welded a nd securely fixed to the supporting frame. 2.3 Heavy-duty guide rollers, sliding track, support brackets, end stops an d anti-derailment arrangements. 2.4 All fabrication, dimensions and anchoring to be suitable for the intend ed security application. 3. Bullet-Resistant Protection 3.1 Bullet-resistant performance shall be provided only when the complet e gate assembly, including steel plate, frame, joints, overlaps and locking arrangements is designed and tested to the required ballistic-resistance le vel. 3.2 The bidder shall specify the applicable ballistic standard and protectio n level and submit valid test reports/certificates from an accredited laborat ory. 3.3 The specified 4 mm sheet thickness alone shall not be considered pro of of bulletproof performance 4. Automatic Operating System 4.1 Heavy-duty electric sliding gate operator with rack and pinion drive, s uitably rated for the actual gate weight and operating frequency. Automatic opening and closing with electronic control 4.2 panel, adjustable travel limits and soft start, soft stop functionality. 4.3 Remote control operation and wall mounted push button control. 4.4 Suitable electrical supply, earthing, overload protection and weather r esistant motor enclosure. 5. Safety and emergency Features

5.1 Safety photocells and obstruction detection/ reversal mechanism. 5.2 Flashing warming light during gate movement. Emergency stop and key operated manual release for power failure. 5.3 Emergency stop and key operated manual release for power fail ure. 5.4 Suitable anti-derailment guides, mechanical end stops and safe opera ting clearances. 6. Surface Treatment 6.1 Surface cleaning and application of anti-corrosive prime followed by d urable exterior grade protective paint of approved powder coating. 6.2 All exposed steel surfaces and fabricated joints to receive suitable cor rosion protection. 7. Warranty. Minimum two year warranty covering the gate automation syste m, motor, control panel and supplied .
